data.title: Add directory sharding for scalability
data.body:
## Goal

Shard bug files into subdirectories to handle large numbers of bugs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Implement sharding: `.docket/bugs/a/abc1.jsonl`
- [ ] Use first character of ID as shard key
- [ ] Migrate existing flat structure on first run
- [ ] Update all file operations to use sharded paths
- [ ] Maintain backward compatibility with flat structure
- [ ] Document when sharding becomes beneficial

## Context

Currently all bugs live in `.docket/bugs/` directly. With thousands of bugs:
- `ls` becomes slow
- File system overhead increases
- Some tools struggle with large directories

Sharding by first character gives 36 buckets (a-z, 0-9), reducing per-directory count significantly.

Lower priority: unlikely to have thousands of bugs in practice.

## Log

- 2026-01-15: Implemented directory sharding in store.rs
  - Added `shard_key()`, `bug_path()`, `bug_path_flat()`, `find_bug_path()`, `migrate_to_sharded()` methods
  - Updated `list_bugs()` to search both sharded and flat structures
  - Updated `get_bug()`, `resolve_id()`, `get_events()` to use `find_bug_path()`
  - Updated `generate_id()` and `generate_child_id()` to check both locations
  - Updated `append_event()` to create shard directories and migrate flat files on update
  - Added documentation to README.md about storage structure and sharding benefits
  - All tests pass, clippy clean
